tests.name: companion messages stay disabled on staging (read-only GET, no member data)

tests.reason: A real Vitana DM is a write to the production database that staging shares, so no send runs on staging (rule 48) and the engine answers disabled-on-staging. The send path is proven offline in vtid-05368: in live mode a member who set nothing up gets exactly one DM whose metadata.card is { kind: 'vitana_card', v: 1, card_type: 'E1', params: {} } and a set-up member gets the morning greeting (F4), never an enrichment card; the default pacer is canSurfaceProactively(member, 'messenger_companion'), once per member, and a paused member gets nothing; a second tick the same local day sends nothing (already_today); staff mode sends the card to staff only; E6/E7 are never offered while the Meta OAuth client is unset.
